title: Pakistan Urges UN Security Council to Press India on Indus Waters Treaty
detail: Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Asim Iftikhar Ahmad, formally wrote to the UNSC President (Bahrain's Ambassador) on behalf of Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, calling on the Security Council to pressure India to restore the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty. India had suspended the treaty following the April 2025 Pahalgam attack. Pakistan demanded restoration of data-sharing, treaty-mandated cooperation, and an end to what Islamabad termed 'water coercion.' India rejected the appeal, reiterating the treaty remains suspended until Pakistan ends support for terrorism.

title: PTI Holds 30th Foundation Day Rally in Muzaffarabad, Renews Calls for Khan's Release
detail: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf held its 30th Foundation Day rally at Lal Chowk, Muzaffarabad, led by KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi. Party leaders renewed calls for Imran Khan's release from Adiala Jail and announced plans for a larger protest in Lahore on May 1. Turnout was modest at roughly 700–850 attendees versus 1,100 chairs, raising questions about PTI's current public mobilization capacity. Khan has been imprisoned since August 2023 across multiple cases including corruption and official secrets violations. The UN Working Group on Arbitrary Detention had previously issued opinions calling his detention arbitrary.

media.caption: PTI Foundation Day rally at Muzaffarabad — modest turnout raises questions about street strength
